scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be registered as a beneficiary under Section 10 (3) of the Act.
Eligibility is excluded if death is due to suicide, drug or substance abuse, or death caused by fighting with each other with intent to commit a crime.
Benefits are provided only on the death of the registered worker, not on death or accident of a family member.
Beneficiaries who have already received assistance under the Financial Assistance and Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme for unorganized workers suffering from silicosis are not eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 on death of the unorganized worker and ₹50,000 on permanent disability.
